name: Azure Active Directory
desc: Manage users, groups, and licenses in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) via Microsoft Graph.

actions.name: add_member_to_group
actions.description: Adds a user or group as a member of an Azure AD group.

actions.name: add_or_remove_user_license
actions.description: Assigns or removes licenses for a user. Use addLicenses to add (include disabledPlans to disable specific service plans) and removeLicenses to remove by SkuId.

actions.name: create_group
actions.description: Creates a new group in Azure Active Directory.

actions.name: create_user
actions.description: Creates a new user in Microsoft Entra ID.

actions.name: delete_group
actions.description: Deletes an Azure AD group by ID.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Deletes a user from Azure Active Directory.

actions.name: get_enabled_users
actions.description: Retrieves a single page of enabled users (accountEnabled eq true).

actions.name: get_group_by_id
actions.description: Retrieves an Azure AD group by its object ID.

actions.name: get_group_custom_attributes
actions.description: Gets extension and custom attributes for an Azure AD group. Returns schema extensions and open extensions.

actions.name: get_user_by_id
actions.description: Retrieves an Azure AD user by object ID or user principal name.

actions.name: list_enabled_users
actions.description: Lists all enabled users in the directory, following nextLink for pagination.

actions.name: list_group_members
actions.description: Lists members of an Azure AD group.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: Lists users in the directory. Supports optional filter and top (page size).

actions.name: reset_custom_attributes
actions.description: Clears extension/custom attributes on a user or group. Provide the resource type and ID, and the extension property names to clear.

actions.name: revoke_sign_in_session
actions.description: Revokes all refresh tokens for the user, forcing them to sign in again.

actions.name: update_user
actions.description: Updates an Azure AD user. Only provide fields you want to change.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_deleted_user
triggers.description: Triggers when a user is deleted from Microsoft Entra ID.

triggers.name: new_group
triggers.description: Triggers when a new group is created in Microsoft Entra ID.

triggers.name: new_user
triggers.description: Triggers when a new user is created in Microsoft Entra ID.
